timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical append time after the Campaign283 final validated state; not a market-data measurement.
objective: Freeze a finite priority-ordered catalog of economically independent issuer external-state mechanisms before any Campaign284 targeted prior-definition or source-frontier search.

catalog_selection_rule.selection_method: After this file is immutable, inspect complete local terminal-definition and source-frontier evidence in catalog priority order. Select the first route that is economically independent and has a lawful auditable 2019-2023 point-in-time issuer identity, availability, revision and complete-market denominator contract. Close every sibling and parameter variant. If no route survives, terminalize Campaign284 before formula, direction, provider, fields, rows or values.

concept_catalog.economic_state: Issuer long-duration labor obligation and operating flexibility reflected in public pension funding deficiency, contribution schedule, regulator intervention, recovery plan, relief and release states.
Issuer fleet availability reflected in public vessel inspection, deficiency, detention, corrective verification, release and repeat-control states.
Issuer aircraft or component operating capacity reflected in public airworthiness directives, grounding, mandated modification, inspection clearance and return-to-service states.
Issuer communications capacity reflected in public spectrum assignment, harmful-interference finding, power or geography restriction, remediation, clearance and restoration states.
Issuer project continuity reflected in public heritage discovery, protection order, archaeological investigation, stop-work, mitigation acceptance and construction-release states.
Issuer emissions-compliance access reflected in public allowance issuance, transfer restriction, surrender, shortfall, account suspension, correction and restoration states.
Issuer food-distribution continuity reflected in public cold-chain inspection, contamination hold, recall, destruction, corrective verification, clearance and channel restoration states.
